successCriteria.description: AuditRecord entity interface exists at src/modules/audit/audit.model.ts with all required fields: id, entityType, entityId, action (typed as AuditAction from shared/types), oldValues (Record<string, unknown> | null), newValues (Record<string, unknown> | null), performedBy, performedAt, ipAddress (string | null), userAgent (string | null), createdAt

IAuditRepository interface extends IBaseRepository<AuditRecord> and adds findByEntity(entityType, entityId), findByPerformedBy(performedBy), and findByDateRange(startDate, endDate) — all accepting optional PoolClient

IAuditService interface exposes log(entry) to persist an AuditRecord, getAuditTrail(filters) to query audit records, and getByEntity(entityType, entityId) to retrieve the audit trail for a specific entity

Notification entity interface exists at src/modules/notification/notification.model.ts with all required fields: id, recipientId, type (typed as NotificationType from shared/types), title, message, relatedEntityType (string | null), relatedEntityId (string | null), status ('UNREAD' | 'READ'), createdAt, readAt (Date | null)

INotificationRepository interface extends IBaseRepository<Notification> and adds findByRecipient(recipientId), findUnreadByRecipient(recipientId), and markAsRead(id) — all accepting optional PoolClient

INotificationService interface exposes send(notification) to create and persist a Notification, getNotifications(recipientId) to list all notifications for a recipient, markAsRead(id) to mark a single notification as READ, and markAllAsRead(recipientId) to mark all unread notifications for a recipient as READ
src/app.ts registers leaveRequestRoutes (from modules/leave-request) and balanceRoutes (from modules/balance) as Fastify plugins alongside the existing uptimeRoutes
balance.routes.ts exists as a Fastify plugin exposing endpoints to query balances by employeeId and by employeeId+leavePolicyId, using BalanceService wired through BalanceRepository

Integration test at tests/integration/leave-request-workflow.spec.ts exercises the full lifecycle: create draft → submit → approve → verify balance deducted → cancel → verify balance restored, using a Fastify instance with all routes registered

constraints: Audit and Notification modules must import from other modules ONLY through their barrel index.ts files (e.g., modules/employee, modules/leave-policy) — never from internal files
AuditRepository and NotificationRepository must extend BaseRepository<T> and use the shared pg Pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts — no inline SQL outside the repository layer (GP-001)
AuditRecord is immutable — the AuditRepository must NOT expose update or delete operations that modify existing records; only create and query methods are permitted
outOfScope: Wiring audit logging into LeaveRequestService state-changing methods (submit, approve, reject, cancel) — the Audit module is built as a standalone capability in this phase; integration into the leave workflow is deferred

Wiring notification sending into LeaveRequestService state-changing methods — the Notification module is built as a standalone capability in this phase; integration into the leave workflow is deferred
Auth middleware, RBAC enforcement, and JWT verification — all routes remain unauthenticated; auth is a cross-cutting concern deferred to a future phase per the reconciled architecture

Database transactions wrapping multi-step writes (BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK) — the transaction contract is planned but not yet implemented; services continue to call repository methods without transaction coordination

ambiguities.description: The AuditService.log method signature is not fully specified — PLAN.md says "log" but does not define a DTO shape. The code agent must decide whether to accept individual parameters (entityType, entityId, action, etc.) or a dedicated DTO interface.
options: Accept a dedicated CreateAuditRecordDto interface with all required fields
Accept individual parameters: log(entityType, entityId, action, oldValues, newValues, performedBy, ...)
Accept a minimal set of required params with optional metadata

entityInvariants.invariant: AuditRecord is immutable once created — no update or delete operations may modify an existing record; the only write operation is create (log)
Notification status transitions: created with status 'UNREAD'; may transition to 'READ' exactly once (setting readAt to the current timestamp); no other status transitions are permitted

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth enforcement in this phase — the performedBy field is caller-supplied
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must throw ValidationError if required fields (entityType, entityId, action, performedBy) are missing or invalid

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth enforcement in this phase
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must throw ValidationError if required fields (recipientId, type, title, message) are missing or invalid

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth enforcement in this phase
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must throw NotFoundError if notification does not exist; must be a no-op (not an error) if notification is already READ

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth enforcement in this phase
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must be a no-op if recipient has no unread notifications; must not throw for nonexistent recipient

consistencyRequirements.requirement: AuditRecord.action must use the AuditAction enum from shared/types/audit-action.enum — values: CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, APPROVE, REJECT
Notification.type must use the NotificationType enum from shared/types/notification-type.enum — values: LEAVE_SUBMITTED, LEAVE_APPROVED, LEAVE_REJECTED, LEAVE_CANCELLED, BALANCE_UPDATED

AuditRepository and NotificationRepository must follow the same pattern as all existing repositories: extend BaseRepository<T>, accept optional PoolClient on every method, and use snake_case column names in SQL matching the reconciled schema (audit_logs table: entity_type, entity_id, old_values, new_values, performed_by, performed_at, ip_address, user_agent; notifications table: recipient_id, related_entity_type, related_entity_id, read_at)

balance.routes.ts must follow the same wiring pattern as leave-request.routes.ts: instantiate BalanceRepository → BalanceService inline (no DI container), and export a default async Fastify plugin function
app.ts must register balanceRoutes and leaveRequestRoutes using the same app.register() pattern already used for uptimeRoutes

integrationPoints.why: Future phase will inject IAuditService and INotificationService into LeaveRequestService to log state changes and send notifications on submit/approve/reject/cancel
